Prologis UK, a leading logistics property owner, developer and investor, has leased DC5b at Prologis Park West London to Relay, supporting the company’s continued expansion across the UK.

The agreement builds on Relay’s successful presence at DC5a Prologis Park West London, where the business established its UK operations and has since experienced significant growth driven by increasing demand for e-commerce delivery services and the securing of new customer contracts.

Relay, a technology-led delivery network transforming last-mile logistics, now handles more than 200,000 parcels each week across the UK. The additional space will provide the capacity needed to support further growth, strengthen operational efficiency and enhance service levels for customers.

The expansion reflects the increasing demand for modern logistics facilities in strategic urban locations, enabling fast and reliable delivery to consumers while supporting the continued growth of e-commerce.

# Hertford Logistics Hub confirms two new leases

By Reuben Henry-Fellows 13th October 2026 2 Mins Read

Padrock has let a further two units at its £75m, 225,340ft² Grade A Hertford Logistics Hub, both on 10-year leases.

Recycling technology manufacturer Pellenc ST has taken 8,290ft² and will run a demonstration, testing and training facility for its technology from the unit.

Hertford Logistics Hub has been developed on an 11-acre brownfield site within the town and comprises 16 urban multi-let industrial (MLI) and logistics leasehold units.

As is standard for Padrock developments, it has achieved best-in-class sustainability credentials, including ‘BREEAM’ Outstanding and EPC ‘A+’ ratings, plus alignment with EU Taxonomy objectives.

results.title: Indurent secures second major Midlands letting with DPD - Indurent
results.text:
Indurent secures second major Midlands letting with DPD - Indurent

# Indurent secures second major Midlands letting with DPD

Indurent, a leading developer, owner and operator of industrial and logistics space across the UK, has signed a new five-year lease with DPD, a leading parcel delivery firm, for c.82,000 sq ft of logistics space at Indurent Park Derby, marking DPD’s second major letting within Indurent’s Midlands portfolio in the last year.

The letting at D82 provides 78,585 sq ft of warehouse space alongside 4,350 sq ft of office facilities. The unit has been designed to high sustainability standards, with a BREEAM Excellent rating, EPC A+ and provision for solar PV, alongside a dedicated warehouse lighting scheme.

The latest agreement builds follows DPD’s letting of c.120,000 sq ft of best-in-class logistics space at Indurent Park Tamworth in October 2025, taking that development to full occupancy. Together, the two leases total over 200,000 sq ft and support DPD’s continued expansion across the Midlands.

Indurent Park Derby comprises approximately 800,000 sq ft across 11 units, with D82 the latest unit to be let. Just one unit, D43, remains available across the scheme

# Halo signs for 25,000 sq ft warehouse at Ford Airfield Industrial Estate

##### By 

##### Simon Creasey

 

- October 12, 2026 

Halo, part of the IRS Group, has signed for a 25,197 sq ft warehouse at Ford Airfield Industrial Estate in Ford, West Sussex.

The accident repair services business has taken Block G at the estate, which comprises industrial and warehouse space, a ground floor reception and ground and first floor office space, along with a large, self-contained yard.

Situated on the south side of the Ford Airfield Industrial Estate, the warehouse is located close to the A259 coastal road, which links with the main A27 coastal highway to the north.

Duncan Marsh, partner at SHW, which acted on behalf of the private investor landlord, said: “The generous yard and strategic location was instrumental in securing this latest letting at Ford Airfield Industrial Estate. We are pleased to welcome Halo to this thriving estate.”

Removals and storage company Perfect Group has leased a 33,720ft² unit at Chancerygate’s £27m Audio Park urban logistics development in Southwater, near Horsham.

The company has relocated from its existing premises in Horsham to the new larger facility.

Perfect Group said the move will provide additional storage capacity and greater operational height to support its growth.

# Leicestershire logistics firm unveils major expansion after nearly 32% growth

28 Aug 2026 | by MHW Magazine Team | Logistics, News

Translink plans to turn its 66,000 sq ft Narborough site into a major indoor pallet sortation centre

A fast-growing Leicestershire logistics firm has announced a major leadership shake-up and plans for a huge new pallet sortation centre after recording almost 32% growth in two years.

Translink Express Logistics has made four senior appointments as the family-run business prepares to celebrate its 40th anniversary next summer.

Three existing employees have been promoted, with Lee Barrett becoming head of traffic, Dan Green taking on the newly created role of head of project management, and Shanice Walsh appointed head of operations.

Ryan Wallis has also joined the company as head of warehousing.

The new management team will take greater responsibility for the day-to-day running of the business, allowing its directors to focus more closely on longer-term growth plans.
